title: Flavonoids Regulate Redox-Responsive Transcription Factors in Glioblastoma and Microglia.
authors: Joma, Natali; Zhang, Issan; Righetto, Germanna L; McKay, Laura; Gran, Evan Rizzel; Kakkar, Ashok; Maysinger, Dusica
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合分子对接与实验探究黄酮类化合物对胶质母细胞瘤和小胶质细胞中氧化还原响应转录因子（如Nrf2-KEAP1）的调控，虽涉及转录因子互作但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法以分子对接为主，与课题部分相关。
abstract: The tumor microenvironment (TME) has emerged as a valuable therapeutic target in glioblastoma (GBM), as it promotes tumorigenesis via an increased production of reactive oxygen species (ROS). Immune cells such as microglia accumulate near the tumor and its hypoxic core, fostering tumor proliferation and angiogenesis. In this study, we explored the therapeutic potential of natural polyphenols with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Notably, flavonoids, including fisetin and quercetin, can protect non-cancerous cells while eliminating transformed cells (2D cultures and 3D tumoroids). We tested the hypothesis that fisetin and quercetin are modulators of redox-responsive transcription factors, for which subcellular location plays a critical role. To investigate the sites of interaction between natural compounds and stress-responsive transcription factors, we combined molecular docking with experimental methods employing proximity ligation assays. Our findings reveal that fisetin decreased cytosolic acetylated high mobility group box 1 (acHMGB1) and increased transcription factor EB (TFEB) abundance in microglia but not in GBM. Moreover, our results suggest that the most powerful modulator of the Nrf2-KEAP1 complex is fisetin. This finding is in line with molecular modeling and calculated binding properties between fisetin and Nrf2-KEAP1, which indicated more sites of interactions and stronger binding affinities than quercetin.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤微环境（TME）已成为胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）中一个有价值的治疗靶点，因为它通过增加活性氧（ROS）的产生促进肿瘤发生。小胶质细胞等免疫细胞聚集在肿瘤及其缺氧核心附近，促进肿瘤增殖和血管生成。在本研究中，我们探讨了具有抗氧化和抗炎特性的天然多酚的治疗潜力。值得注意的是，包括非瑟酮和槲皮素在内的黄酮类化合物，可以保护非癌细胞，同时消除转化细胞（2D培养和3D肿瘤类器官）。我们测试了假设，即非瑟酮和槲皮素是氧化还原响应转录因子的调节剂，其中亚细胞定位起着关键作用。为了研究天然化合物与应激响应转录因子之间的相互作用位点，我们将分子对接与采用邻近连接实验的实验方法相结合。我们的研究结果表明，非瑟酮降低了小胶质细胞中胞质乙酰化高迁移率族蛋白B1（acHMGB1）的水平，并增加了转录因子EB（TFEB）的丰度，但在GBM中未观察到这一效应。此外，我们的结果提示，Nrf2-KEAP1复合物最强大的调节剂是非瑟酮。这一发现与分子建模及非瑟酮与Nrf2-KEAP1之间计算的结合特性一致，表明其比槲皮素具有更多的相互作用位点和更强的结合亲和力。
